parole.significato: The spindle-shaped embryo stage of Acanthocephala that burrows into the body cavity of its first intermediate host.
parole.testo: From New Latin acanthus (“spine”) (extracted from taxonomic name Acanthocephala) + -or (condition).

parole.significato: Any grass of the genus Agrostis of bentgrasses.
parole.testo: From New Latin agrōstis, via the genus name taxonomic name Agrostis.
